findings.primary_bottleneck: the preregistered shared core thresholds for material absolute range width and low absolute directional efficiency reject all 15 false-negative Stage0 references before either positive channel can become TRUE
findings.range_width_core: 8 of 15 false negatives fail the lenient range-width median threshold
findings.directional_efficiency_core: 8 of 15 false negatives fail the lenient low-efficiency median threshold
findings.overlap: 1 false negative fails both shared-core predicates
findings.relocation_guard: 3 false negatives also trigger the frozen 008 relocation guard, but all 3 were already rejected by the positive-instability shared core; relocation is not the dominant D2 failure
findings.stage_2_guard: no false negative is attributed to unchanged Stage2 as the decisive cause
findings.expansion_profile_redundancy: within each fixed core/reversal profile, all three expansion profiles produced identical development metrics; the expansion threshold was not the binding dimension in this frozen grid
findings.semantic_interpretation: the two-channel design remains directionally plausible, but the D implementation made both channels pass through one cross-sectional shared core that is too restrictive for the development references
